name: VideoScribe
summary: Whiteboard and hand-drawn animation software for explainer and training videos: build scenes from a large image library, add text, music and voiceover, with AI tools for scripts, images and voiceovers; priced per licence by downloads and video length.
best_for: trainers and L&D, HR and marketing teams that want hand-drawn whiteboard explainer videos without hiring an animator
skip_if: you need presenter or avatar videos, live-action editing or videos longer than 20 minutes; or you want to try a paid plan with a refund window, since payments are non-refundable
honest_knock: Payments are non-refundable according to the help centre, and a monthly plan must be cancelled at least three business days before the next payment. Lite still watermarks premium images and caps you at 5 downloads of up to 5 minutes a month; AI voiceover starts on Core. Monthly billing costs more than twice the annual rate.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Lite · per month, per licence, billed annually at €165
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-18 in a browser on videoscribe.co/pricing in the monthly and annual view, from a Netherlands connection, prices shown in euros; the cards do not say whether tax is included) Three paid plans, priced per licence. Lite is €34.00 a month billed monthly, or €13.75 a month billed annually at €165.00: 5 video downloads a month, videos up to 5 minutes, watermarks only on premium images. Core is €55.00 monthly, or €22.92 a month at €275.00 a year: 30 downloads a month, videos up to 10 minutes, 5M premium images and icons, no watermark on videos, preview links and training bundles. Max is €70.00 monthly, or €29.17 a month at €350.00 a year: unlimited downloads, videos up to 20 minutes, reseller rights, custom fonts and a brand kit. All plans include unlimited projects, the music library and Full HD MP4 downloads. The AI tools are metered per month: image generation 5, 20, 50 and 100 on Free, Lite, Core and Max; script generation 2, 30, 75 and 150 minutes; AI voiceover none on Free and Lite, 75 minutes on Core and 150 on Max. The free trial lasts 7 days with no credit card: 3 downloads, videos up to 5 minutes, watermarked. VideoScribe's help centre says payments already made are non-refundable, with refund requests about unresolved technical problems considered individually.

compare_with.name: Synthesia
compare_with.why: Synthesia is in our dossiers too and also sells to training teams, but it makes a different kind of video: AI avatars reading a script, metered in credits, with Starter at $29 a month or $18 billed yearly when we read it on 1 October 2026. VideoScribe makes whiteboard and hand-drawn animation, priced per licence by downloads and video length. Choose by format: a presenter on screen points to Synthesia, a drawn explanation to VideoScribe.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 2 November 2026 on the free trial: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We built a two-scene storyboard with our own test text and downloaded it as one MP4. We did not open Purchase now.
findings: The trial banner read 'Free Trial - 6 days 23h 58m 54s remaining', which matches the 7-day trial on the pricing page, and said to purchase to remove VideoScribe watermarks.
Before downloading, the dialog said 'You have 3 of your 3 downloads remaining': the trial counts downloads. One MP4 in HD 1080p downloaded without problems.
Hand-drawing defaults to 2 seconds per element; our two scenes ran 2.5 seconds each. A long line of text ran past the edge of the frame instead of wrapping.
The editor shows its limits plainly: 25 scenes, 150 image elements, 50 audio tracks and 300 MB of audio per project.
The share dialog warns that anyone with the preview link can watch without signing in, and GIF exports stop after the first 15 seconds.
